title: Qualcomm Hexagon NPU
description: Complete reference for building custom inference engines on Hexagon NPU. Covers VLIW architecture, HVX vector programming, HTA/HMX tensor accelerators, and on-device inference optimization.

modules.title: Hexagon SoC Architecture Internals
modules.description: PhD-level reference on the Qualcomm Hexagon processor: scalar VLIW core, HVX vector unit, HTA/HMX tensor accelerators, hardware threading, memory hierarchy, ISA, SoC integration, and generational evolution from v65 to v75.

modules.title: HVX (Hexagon Vector eXtensions) Programming Model
modules.description: PhD-level deep technical coverage of HVX programming: register architecture, intrinsic families, data types, convolution and GEMM kernels, predicates, software pipelining, and inline assembly. Primary mechanism for high-throughput mobile ML inference on Hexagon DSP cores.

modules.title: HTA / HMX (Tensor & Matrix Accelerators)
modules.description: The Hexagon Tensor Accelerator (HTA) and Matrix Accelerator (HMX) — descriptor-driven programming model, 32x32 systolic array architecture, INT8/INT16/FP16/INT4 data formats, HTA+HVX pipeline orchestration, and triple-buffering optimization.

modules.title: Memory Subsystem Mastery
modules.description: Deep dive into Hexagon's memory hierarchy: VTCM (Vector TCM), DMA engines, cache management, double-buffering strategies, and bandwidth optimization for ML workloads.

modules.title: Quantization for Hexagon
modules.description: INT8/INT4/INT2 quantization strategies for Hexagon: requantization pipelines, accuracy preservation, per-channel/per-tensor quantization, and hardware-accelerated requantize operations.

modules.title: Operator Kernel Design
modules.description: Designing high-performance ML operator kernels for Hexagon: Conv2D, GEMM, attention, layer norm, and softmax kernels optimized for HVX and HMX.

modules.title: Inference Engine Architecture
modules.description: Building production inference engines on Hexagon: graph IR, operator fusion, memory planning, scheduling, and runtime architecture for end-to-end model execution.

modules.title: Performance Analysis & Profiling
modules.description: Performance methodology for Hexagon: roofline analysis, bottleneck identification, profiling tools (PMU, Hexagon Profiler), and systematic optimization workflow.

modules.title: Toolchain & Development Environment
modules.description: Hexagon SDK, cross-compilation, debugging, simulation, deployment workflows, and CI/CD integration for embedded ML inference.

modules.title: Research Frontiers & Advanced Topics
modules.description: Cutting-edge research directions for Hexagon: sparsity exploitation, INT4 inference, LLM on mobile NPUs, neural architecture search for Hexagon, and future hardware trends.
